Nested blockquote produces double-prefixed lines

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<blockquote><p>Outer quote.</p><blockquote><p>Inner quote.</p></blockquote></blockquote>"
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
